reviews.text: Since they insist on holding my dogs flea medication hostage (that she's been on for a while now) until i take her in for an unnecessary appointment which i can not afford I will no longer be taking any of my pets to this crappy establishment. I found another Vet that has much better service and prices. SHAME on Olympic pet hospital for torturing dogs!

This was my second time coming, and luckily both times it wasn't for anything too serious, however I feel a bit scammed. The thing that's bothering me the most after the fact was that after the 3 minute exam, Dr. Kwon told me to put my dog in my car and come back in and get the medicine. It's 82 degrees out. I was absolutely shocked he suggested something like that. That alone is why I'm leaving a review, but there's more. Both times I've come here, the exam the vets conducted were from a distance, rushed, and had me wondering if I was being scammed. The meds, however, are legit. I wouldn't come here again unless I'm only looking to get some prescription meds for my dog, and I bet I could find a better place to be honest. Both times, they seemed like they were scared of my dog, didn't touch or really interact with him, and rushed through the exam and any questions. This was my second time feeling this way over a 5 minute exam that costs around 80 bucks. I understand they may have a lot of patients but it felt like they have no interest in building a relationship with my dog or me. The front desk girl was really kind and talked me through their policies. The other lowkey looked like she wanted to chop my head off when I came in 😭. Going to emphasize after like 10 minutes of waiting in a pretty noisy room, Dr. Kwon came in and rushed through an pretty lackadaisical exam, then told me to put my dog in the car and come back in to get my medicine... I was honestly just gonna keep it pushing and find a new vet but as I was driving home and thinking about it, it just rubbed me the wrong way. Like no way he cares for my dog's well being if he's so casually telling me to put my dog in my car in the hot LA weather. And then I never saw him again, the front desk girl handled the prescriptions. I spent more time talking with her than the actual vet, and she even smiled at my dog...which the vet didn't do
The vets are great,and offer good affordable care. The front desk staff is friendly and vet tech Eric is really knowledgeable And always gets back to me when I have questions.
I went to get help for my cat who was in severe pain and this place was amazing! Especially the older gentlemen was so sweet. Thank you!

I am writing to warn other pet owners about the alarming decline in care at this clinic. After being a client for over 15 years, I am shocked by their lack of professionalism and their decision to "fire" me for speaking up about my dog’s safety.
1. Fabricated Medical Data & Poor Service:
The front desk was dismissive and rude. They skipped weighing my dog entirely but later "made up" a weight of 6 lbs. My dog actually weighs 5.6 lbs. For a small dog, this 10% error is dangerous for medication dosing.
2. The "Visual" Ear Exam (Highly Unprofessional):
When I confronted the doctor about skipping the ear exam, the response was that she  "looked at the ears from a distance" and decided they looked fine, so she  didn't feel the need to communicate further. This is medically unacceptable. A routine physical exam requires a hands-on check, not a "guess" from across the room. Skipping standard procedures without informing the pet parent is a major breach of trust.
3. Retaliatory Dismissal:
Instead of apologizing for these clear oversights, the doctor has now refused to provide further service because I dared to leave a negative review. This is blatant retaliation. Rather than improving their flawed protocols, they chose to abandon a patient of 15 years.
This clinic has traded medical integrity for laziness. If you want a vet who actually performs the exams you pay for and doesn't retaliate against honest feedback, please go elsewhere. Their "visual check" is no substitute for real medicine. The owner’s solution to their rude receptionists is to call customers and tell them they can no longer be served. Absolutely absurd. Instead of training their staff to be professional, they kick out the customers who point out the truth. Truly the worst management I have ever seen.
P.S .check out their reviews about front desk staff

P.S . go to modern animal hospital VIP service and much reasonable price.

This vet clinic is way better than a national chain. My dog was misdiagnosed on a Saturday with pancreatitis at a national veterinary chain company, with that vet insisting she needed to be hospitalized for 3 to 4 days, minimum cost $5000.  I love my dog dearly, but she is quite elderly, has major spinal issues and dementia problems, and she needs to constantly be with me or she stresses. Putting her in hospital would break her. That vet acted as if I were a horrible human. Worse, though that vet prescribed pain medication for her, he didn’t give his required vet code. Since it was a controlled substance, the pharmacy wouldn’t give it to me. So though he went on about how intense her pain was, he made it impossible for her to get the pain reliever he insisted she needed! Thank goodness Olympic Pet Hospital was recommended to me: They got me in at 10 AM on a Monday holiday! Dr. Lucia Kwon was kind and diligent. She truly listened to me. Not only did she prescribe an effective non-controlled substance but she made sure it would help with my dog’s spinal and nerve pain. When she discovered I had given a friend’s cat subcutaneous IV daily, she assured me I could do the same for my dog if her condition deteriorated and she needed help with fluids. That way, I wouldn’t have to hospitalize her if things got worse. I cannot speak more highly of this woman — knowledgable, thoughtful, gentle with my baby and reassuring to me. My dog was better in 1.5 days under her treatment protocol. I just wish I would have gone to her on Saturday; that would have saved me the $40O I wasted at the substandard national chain. And my dog wouldn’t have suffered for two days. I would give this clinic and vet 10 out of 5 stars if I could.

I visited this vet regularly for three years and the amount of disappointment of care from the minute you come in with the stark and awkward interactions between the rude recipients  and am the vet who struggles and misdiagnosed my dog.

Gave my dog 6 months to live, it’s been 3 years. Provided my dog heart medication almost $300 a month he did not need. My dog got a scratch in his eye, said there was nothing they can do and sent me to a specialist. Specialist (Integrative Eye Ophthalmology) took a picture with an IPHONE and said my dog was fine as the red were clearly red blood vessels forming. Hundreds of dollars for something an iPhone was able to see but not my dogs’ primary doctors. Dr. Kwon and Lucia are frauds in my humble opinion. I am more angry at myself that I let convenience keep me coming back to you guys for a shameful 4 years even though there were consistent issues. Asked for flea medication, I need to pay $85 for a check up first per dog LOL

Editing because check the reviews! They have family and friends giving 5 stars don’t be fooled by the ratings, they said they’ll email me my dogs’ records and I have yet to receive them.

Editing ** I just called to remind them about providing my dogs’ medical records to which they responded “Yes! Sorry we forgot, it’s been busy, but we have 48 hours.” YES YOU HAVE 48 HOURS BUT YOU CLOSE IN TWO HOURS FOR THE NEXT TWO DAYS!!! They are so unorganized and quite frankly idiotic. They forgot they’re closed the weekend or what?

Hands down, Dr. Lucia and Dr. Eric are some of the most caring and professional vets I’ve ever met! They were so kind and patient with our little Mocha  who, to be honest, gets super nervous around strangers and vet visits.

Both doctors took their time to answer every single question we had and made sure Mocha felt safe the entire time. Their gentle approach truly helped him relax . I could actually see him tail start wagging again by the end of the visit! 🥹

What I really love about this clinic is that they focus on what truly matters. No unnecessary tests, no “let’s do everything just in case” attitude . just honest, thoughtful, and professional care. It’s so refreshing to meet vets who genuinely care more about the pet than the profit.

If your fur baby gets anxious like Mocha, this is the place to go. I trust Dr. Lucia and Dr. Eric completely  they’re simply the best! 💕🐶
